docs_description: How the Mochifile API is designed to work: compress, convert and merge files from your own code. A preview of a product that is not available yet.
docs_lead: Process images and PDFs from your own code. The API is planned and not available yet: this page shows how it is designed to work.
docs_notice: Preview: the API does not exist yet. Endpoint names, parameters, headers and limits are a proposal until it does, and nothing on this page can be called today.
docs_overview_base: All requests will go to one base URL:
docs_overview_base_note: Planned address. It does not answer yet.
docs_overview_count: Each file returned counts as one operation, however many changes were applied to it. Asking for several formats or sizes of one file counts one operation per output.
docs_auth_text: The plan is that a few operations need no key. After that you create a key in your account and send it as a Bearer token. Accounts are not available yet.
docs_auth_callout: Keys are shown once, when you create them. Store them somewhere safe. You can revoke a key and create a new one at any time.
docs_compress_text: Compress and, if you ask, convert or resize a single image. Send the raw file as the request body. The response body is the resulting file.
docs_compress_comment: Bring a photo under 50 KB, keep it as JPG
docs_p_format: Output format: `jpg`, `png` or `webp`. By default the photo keeps its own format.
docs_p_maxsize: Largest allowed result, for example `50kb`. Mochifile finds the best quality that fits. If nothing fits, the response is `422` with the smallest size it reached.
docs_p_width: Target width in pixels. The aspect ratio is kept unless `height` is also set.
docs_p_fit: How to fill width × height: `contain`, `cover` or `square`.
docs_p_quality: Encoder quality from 1 to 100. Ignored when `maxSize` is set.
docs_p_keepmetadata: Results are re-encoded from pixels, so EXIF and GPS data are removed unless this is `true`.
docs_p_background: Fill colour used when a transparent image is saved as JPG.
docs_h_original: Size of the uploaded file in bytes.
docs_h_result: Size of the returned file in bytes.
docs_h_resized: Present when the image was made smaller in pixels to fit; holds the new width × height.
docs_h_remaining: Operations left in the current period.
docs_convert_text: Change the format of a single image without changing its size. Send the raw file as the request body. The response body is the resulting file.
docs_convert_comment: Turn a WebP into a JPG
docs_pdf_text: Combine several images or PDFs into one PDF, in the order you send them. The response body is the PDF.
docs_jobs_text: Check on a request that is still being processed. Does not count as an operation.
docs_e_400_do: A parameter is missing or has the wrong type.
docs_e_401_do: The API key is missing, wrong or revoked.
docs_e_413_do: The file is over the size limit for your plan.
docs_e_415_do: The file is not an image or PDF format we accept.
docs_e_422_do: The image cannot reach `maxSize`. The body says the smallest size reached.
docs_e_429_do: You used this period’s operations. The `Retry-After` header says when they reset.
docs_e_500_do: Something went wrong on our side. Retrying is safe.
docs_tools_heading: CLI, MCP servers and Chrome extension
docs_cli_text: Install once, then compress, convert and resize from any shell or script.
docs_mcp_text: Local (stdio) for desktop agents, or hosted with sign-in for AI chats.
docs_chrome_text: Adds “Convert to” to the right-click menu of any image.
docs_help_text: Ask on GitHub so the answer stays searchable for the next person, or email us.
